extraction_warnings: PDF source uses 8-digit codes without dots (e.g., '13012000', '13019011'). Normalized to NNNN.NN.NN format (e.g., '1301.20.00', '1301.90.11') per project schema. 6-digit subheading numbers in PDF (e.g., '130190', '130219', '130232', '130239') normalized to NNNN.NN (e.g., '1301.90', '1302.19', '1302.32', '1302.39').

PDF table-chrome headers ('SI.No. Notes Notification No Notification Date', 'SI.No. Notes Notification Date Notification No', 'Itc(hs) Code. Description Export Policy Policy Condition', 'Main Notes', 'Policy Condition', 'Export Licensing Notes', 'Product Description and Export Policy') were recognized as table chrome and EXCLUDED from the legal notes per extraction rules.
Section II Main Note about 'pellets' appears on PDF page 1 above the Chapter 13 title and is attributed to section_notes (Section II, Vegetable Products), not chapter_notes.

Chapter 13 has only one chapter note (Note 1), which is a long compound exclusion clause spanning sub-items (a)-(j). Each excluded product class was split into a separate exclusion_clauses entry while preserving the source_note_text verbatim.

Policy Condition 3 in the source PDF begins with a '?' character (rendered before 'The export of Food Supplements...') and contains a second '?' character mid-text before 'The export of Food Supplements containing botanicals to European Union (EU) and United Kingdom (UK) originating in or consigned from India and intended for human or animal consumption, also allowed...'. These '?' characters appear to be OCR/encoding artifacts (likely intended as bullet markers or quote characters) and are preserved verbatim as they appear in the source.

Tariff line 1301.90.16 description 'Natural gums: ---- Karaya gum (Indian tragacanth) hastab' — 'hastab' appears as truncated text in the source PDF (no further continuation visible). Preserved verbatim.

Tariff line 1301.90.17 description in PDF wraps across two rows: 'Natural gums: ---- Tragacanth (adraganth)'. The continuation '(adraganth)' appears in a separate cell on page 4. Reconstructed as a single description.

Subheading 1302.32 description in PDF reads 'Mucilages and thickeners, whether or not modified, derived from vegetable products : -- Mucilages and thickeners, whether or not modified, derived from locust beans, locust bean seeds or guar seeds' — the word 'seeds' appears on the next page as a continuation. Reconstructed verbatim.

Policy Condition column shows 'Subject to Policy Condition 1 of the Chapter' for heading 1301 tariff lines, 'Subject to Policy Condition 2 &3 of the Chapter' for most heading 1302 tariff lines, and 'Subject to Policy Condition 2 of the Chapter' for subheading 1302.31 onwards (mucilages/thickeners). Notification details ('31/2015-20', '53/2023', dated '29.09.2017', '15.12.2023') captured in policy_conditions.

Export Licensing Notes section for Chapter 13 contains a single row stating: 'Export of quantities of wheat flour to Maldives shall be permitted through the PSUs indicated.' with Notification Date '27.06.2017' and Notification No '12/2015-20'. This note is unrelated to Chapter 13 product scope (wheat flour falls under Chapter 11) and appears to be a misplaced or template entry in the source PDF — preserved verbatim as it appears in the Chapter 13 PDF.

Several tariff lines under heading 1301 have empty Export Policy and Policy Condition cells in the source PDF for the parent subheading rows ('130190' / 1301.90 'Other'). These rows are subheading-level rows, not tariff lines, and are represented as subheadings in the structure.

chapter_notes.text: Heading 1302 applies, inter alia, to liquorice extract and extract of pyrethrum, extract of hops, extract of aloes and opium. The heading does not apply to: (a) liquorice extract containing more than 10% by weight of sucrose or put up as confectionery (heading 1704); (b) malt extract (heading 1901); (c) extracts of coffee, tea or mate (heading 2101); (d) vegetable saps or extracts constituting alcoholic beverages (Chapter 22); (e) camphor, glycyrrhizin or other products of heading 2914 or 2938; (f) concentrates of poppy straw containing not less than 50% by weight of alkaloids (heading 2939); (g) medicaments of heading 3003 or 3004 or blood - grouping reagents (heading 3882); (h) tanning or dyeing extracts (heading 3201 or 3203); (i) essential oils, concretes, absolutes,resinoids, extracted oleoresins, aqueous distillates or aqueous solutions of essential oils or preparations based on odoriferous substances of a kind used for the manufacture of beverages (Chapter 33); or (j) natural rubber, balata, gutta-percha, guayule, chicle or similar natural gums (heading 4001).

section_notes.text: In this Section, the term "pellets" means products which have been agglomerated either directly by compression or by the addition of a binder in a proportion not exceeding 3 (percent) by weight.
